title: Target anatomy
view: Sagittal section through the right maxillary canine seen from the patient's right: the lip on the image right, the palate on the left, the nasal floor at the top.
teachingPoint: The root apex sits above the mucobuccal fold inside porous maxilla; the needle enters at the fold and runs up along the tooth to the bone surface level with the apex, and the fluid soaks through to the nerve.
claims: Canine root above the mucobuccal fold (record anatomy).
Porous (cancellous) maxilla behind a thin labial plate (record anatomy; standard anatomy).
Needle from the fold, angled toward the apex, tip at the bone surface level with the apex, outside the bone (record steps 4-5).
Teal: injectate along the bone surface near the apex (record steps 6; supraperiosteal).
Branch of the superior alveolar nerve reaching the apex (standard anatomy).
Labels: Root apex, Mucobuccal fold, Porous maxilla, Superior alveolar nerve, Upper lip.

geometry.why: the apex sits above the fold
the needle stays off the tooth
the needle comes up from the fold toward the apex
the nerve runs in the bone
